# Lab 13.3: AI.GENERATE_TABLE & Typed Functions

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the typed functions AI.GENERATE_BOOL, AI.GENERATE_INT and AI.GENERATE_DOUBLE, then turn text into a table with AI.GENERATE_TABLE and a remote model.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Typed scalar functions.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title,
  AI.GENERATE_BOOL(CONCAT('Does this review recommend the movie? ', review)).result AS recommends,
  AI.GENERATE_INT(CONCAT('How many actors are named in this review? ', review)).result AS actors_named,
  AI.GENERATE_DOUBLE(CONCAT('Score this review sentiment from -1.0 to 1.0: ', review)).result AS sentiment
FROM lab13.reviews
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create a remote Gemini model.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab13.gemini
REMOTE WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (endpoint = 'gemini-3.5-flash');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Extract a table from text.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT *
FROM AI.GENERATE_TABLE(
  MODEL lab13.gemini,
  (SELECT title, CONCAT('From this review, list the movie title, the reviewer mood and the best scene: ', review) AS prompt
   FROM lab13.reviews LIMIT 10),
  STRUCT('movie STRING, mood STRING, best_scene STRING' AS output_schema, 256 AS max_output_tokens)
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] Save the generated table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --destination_table=lab13.review_facts --replace \
"SELECT movie, mood, best_scene FROM AI.GENERATE_TABLE(MODEL lab13.gemini,
  (SELECT CONCAT('From this review, list the movie title, the reviewer mood and the best scene: ', review) AS prompt FROM lab13.reviews LIMIT 10),
  STRUCT('movie STRING, mood STRING, best_scene STRING' AS output_schema))"
bq head lab13.review_facts</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `AI.GENERATE_BOOL/INT/DOUBLE` | One typed value per row |
| `AI.GENERATE_TABLE` | Table output from a remote model |
| Remote model | `lab13.gemini` over `us.lab_conn` |
| Output table | `lab13.review_facts` |
